Subject: MAP draft: SOC 2 package delivery - next steps

Hi Lena / Carlos —

Great speaking with you earlier — thanks for the time. Per our discovery call, attaching the initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the Aurelia <> Redwood engagement (see attachment name below). I captured the security milestone we discussed so it’s clear who’s responsible and when we expect delivery. Quick recap and ask:

- Goal: Deliver SOC 2 package (questionnaire + evidence) and complete security review so procurement can finalize contract.
- Target close date (commercial): 2026-04-01 (we can adjust if needed).
- Security milestone (MAP): Redwood to provide completed SOC 2 questionnaire and evidence bundle by 2026-03-05. Aurelia to review and sign off by 2026-03-12.

Milestone: SOC 2 package delivery
- Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole / Neha Kapoor
- Owner (Aurelia): Lena Park
- Deliverables from Redwood: completed SOC2-Questionnaire-v1.xlsx, Evidence-Request-Template.docx populated, S3 evidence list export (S3-evidence-list.csv).
- Dependencies: access to audit logs for 2025, confirmation of MSP attestation for hosted infra, procurement PO terms alignment.
- Next steps: Redwood to send completed questionnaire + evidence links by EOD 2026-03-05. Propose a checkpoint call on 2026-03-09 to review gaps.

Attachments: MAP-draft-AureliaTech-20260224.pdf (attached).

Could you confirm the due dates above work for your team and who your procurement contact is for the final contract/PO? I’ll update the MAP and push an updated copy to the HubSpot deal.

Thanks —
Marissa

marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear MAP draft. Confirming Aurelia can review the package on the timeline but we do have two requests/dependencies to call out now:

1) We need the standard SOC 2 questionnaire completed (we prefer XLSX). Please return using the attached template.
2) We’ll need evidence for the items listed in the Evidence Request Template (examples: configuration snapshots, ASG/ALB logs, user access lists, change control tickets). If you can provide an S3 export or secure SharePoint link that would be ideal.

Tentative internal reviewers: myself (security lead) and Carlos (CTO) — procurement will handle contract paperwork once security signs off.

Proposed due dates look OK: questionnaire + evidence by 2026-03-05, Aurelia review complete by 2026-03-12. If anything drifts we’ll flag immediately.

Attaching: SOC2-Questionnaire-v1.xlsx, Evidence-Request-Template.docx

Best,
Lena Park
Security Lead, Aurelia Tech
security@aurelia.com

Internal plan and owners (short):

- Dev: will export ALB/ASG logs for Jan-Dec 2025 and provide presigned S3 link by 2026-02-27. Note: some older logs are archived — Dev will list retention gaps in S3-evidence-list.csv.
- David: will pull config snapshots (Terraform state + runtime config) and produce access lists (IAM roles, admin users) by 2026-03-02.
- Neha: will complete questionnaire answers for security controls sections and validate evidence mappings; I’ll do a dry run of the completed package on 2026-03-03.

Risks/dependencies:
- We need the MSP/infra provider attestation by 2026-03-01 to fully satisfy control SC-6. Rafael — can you confirm the MSP contact?
- If logs need retrieval from archive, delivery may slip by up to 3 business days. Will flag early.

I’ll upload the initial bundle to the secure Drive folder and paste the link into the HubSpot MAP when ready.

-Neha

Marissa / Neha — thanks for the update and plan. A couple quick items from our side:

- We require either an MSP attestation doc or the MSP’s SOC report for any managed infra. If you don’t have the attestation we’ll need written confirmation and contact details for the MSP so we can request it.
- For the audit logs: we prefer a read-only presigned S3 link (7-day expiry) rather than zipped attachments. Please provide the link in the Drive folder you mentioned.

We’ll schedule a 30-minute checkpoint on Mon 2026-03-09 to walk through any gaps before our final review. Proposed time: 10:00 AM PT. Please confirm and send the meeting invite.

Thanks,
Lena
